correctness.rationale: The fixed-base coefficient map is invertible; jets of the auxiliary quadrics establish transverse zero-dimensional critical locus away from the forced line; second jets force ordinary nodes; independent two-point jets exclude coincident critical values, including the proportional-evaluation stratum. Smoothness of the total space gives transverse smoothing; Euler characteristic -88 yields precisely 136. Exact standalone Chern and jet calculations reproduce critical linear algebra; they are not treated as a genericity certificate.

value.rationale: A full singular-fiber census (not a mere Euler-derived conditional number) supplies the reduced discriminant degree and complete local Picard–Lefschetz profile for a naturally constrained K3-fibered Calabi–Yau family central to recent generalized-complete-intersection mirror symmetry. The special forced line makes transversality nonautomatic. This is a motivated structural input to degeneration and monodromy studies, distinct from recomputing known Hodge numbers.
